content: Ofona-nwa kwa Lẹvi ọmaana ọkkọra-kwanọng kwẹ

K'ogbe nwuma wa anọng p'Israẹl ọvaarnọng kakhaam. Iwa ọkhaam ojinọng wani kw'efonamma cha Lẹvi, kw'orukhi k'ẹtzaanga-ẹtzaanga kw'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho s'Ephraim, kw'ọtzọk ọkkọra-kwanọng kw'ofon Bẹtẹlẹhẹm ka Juda.
Yina, wa ọkkọra-kwanọng nwa osi ẹmmaana-tzama otzima otzor odim. Wa obin oji odim, ọkpa nnam k'otte k'ọhọhm ka Bẹtẹlẹhẹm kwa Juda. Mada okk'aphe anna owobha kẹ,
odim obina ttara atzọhmnọng pẹ ọmaana nnyanyaang sẹ mfa, bi ọtza okhukh-ẹ ọkpa nnam. Mando kwa kwanọng nwa otzim odim, ọnwa k'ọhọhm kw'otte. Mada otte kwa kwanọng ọrẹ-ẹ, ọgọm-ẹ ttara ottem-daamiji.
Ọnyẹ kwẹ kw'ode otte kwa kwanọng, ophyem-ẹ bi obhing, mando kw'obhingi ttara bẹ k'iwu ittaan. Om-ochi obiro ogwo, obiro ọttaabha mẹ.
Ottong iwu inna, bẹ abina k'ekpekpebha ado for bi, bẹ afona. Yina, otte kwa kwanọng oben odim kwa nnwa bi, “Kọ bọkha ẹbhọhr yina afona.”
Mando kwa bẹ anọng afa awobh ibe rani achi ọchattọhk abira agwo atzuk. Mada bẹ akk'akyera, otte kwa kwanọng oben bi, “Tzotzokhaan, tte ettem ẹdaam-ọ bi, awobha ma m'erungiwu nda.”
Yina, k'ogbe kw'ojinọng nwa obin bi ofona, otte kwa kwanọng oden-ẹ maa, okhera oyima m'erungiwu nduma.
K'ekpebha ch'ewu ehobh, ch'ettong iwu izen, mada obin bi ofona, otte kwa kwanọng oben bi, “Kọ bọkha ẹbhọhr, awobha maa, apyiri k'ẹya!” Mando kwa bẹ atzọni achi ọttọhk.

K'ogbe kw'ojinọng nwa, ọmaana ọkkọra-kwanọng kwẹ ttara ọtzọhmnọng kwẹ abin bi afona, ọnyẹ kwẹ kw'ode otte kwa kwanọng, oben bi, “Kker e, erungi en-ekkekkeni epyi e, chi ọttọhk yima ma e; kkeri ewu ẹkk'ẹha e. Iphyini ekpekpebha, abina abhana k'ọhọhm kwọ e.”
Yina, wa itta nwa kẹ kọdaakhi bi obiro oyima mẹ k'erungiwu ẹdọdọk. Wa odo nnyanyaang sẹ ewobha, otzima ọkkọra-kwanọng kwẹ obina orenga ochina k'okhubha kwa Jẹbus (kw'ode Jẹrusalẹm).
K'ogbe kwa bẹ akk'Jebus abaanga, da ewu en-ebubha, ọtzọhmnọng kw'ojinọng nwa oben itta kwẹ bi, “Tte mobhing m'odedenmon kw'anọng pa Jẹbus m'erungiwu nda e.”
Itta kwẹ obhina ọtzọhmnọng nwa bi, “Mma e, man k'odedenmon manda wani kw'oni kw'anọng p'Israẹl ode kọ́tza. Ottu kw'am-osi mando, mọkwọbha óchina ka Gibea.
Tte mokhonga opyiri ka Gibea, obiro ode Rama, ifha moyima m'obhon wani kw'ibhon nna ifa e.”
Mando kwa be achin ororo maa, bẹ atza abaanga Gibea k'ẹkhọma cha Bẹnjamin, ka nchọhkha-bọhk.
Bẹ atza akwọbha ka Gibea bi bẹ abhing m'erungiwu nduma. Bẹ afona atza awobha ẹwọr ka nttaanga-chi s'odedenmon. Yina, ọnọng mando wani kw'oyeri bẹ bi, bẹ atza k'ọhọhm kwẹ kode.

M'ẹchọhkha nduma, ọtzaminọng-jinọng wani kw'ofon k'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho s'Ephraim, oruk ka Gibea ofona k'owoni kw'osi ọtzọhm okhuna. Wa anọng pa Gibea p'iwa arukhi m'ibe nna ade anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Bẹnjamin.
Mada ọtzaminọng nwa otzini chen okkeri ka nttaanga-chi s'odedenmon, ọn-ọbọbh bi, “Bọng afon man o? Bọng am-achina man o?”

Ofona-nwa nwa kwa Lẹvi, obhina bi, “Mofon ka Bẹtẹlẹhẹm k'ẹkhọma cha Juda, om-ochina k'ẹtzaanga-ẹtzaanga kw'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho s'Ephraim, kẹ da kaam nnukhi. Wa kaam nda Bẹtẹlẹhẹm k'ẹkhọma cha Juda, ma, kaam nna nchin k'ọhọhm kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Ọnọng manda wani kw'ọkk'aam otzima bi, nda nyima k'ibe sẹ kode.
Maman ọttọhk manda vani korori. Mọkhaam araraari-bukhi ọmaana ọchattọhk fa nnyanyaang saman ka e. Mọkhaama brẹd ọmaana atzuk p'abenga kaam ọmaana kwanọng kwaam ttara odikkobh nwa.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, ọtzaminọng nwa oben bi, “Bọng kwu wobha k'ọhọhm kwaam. Bọng ma nttaanga-chi nna kàwobha. Tte nnang bọng ọttọhk kpenamkpen fa bọng aror.”
Mando kw'ọtzaminọng nwa otzim ojinọng nwa ochina k'ọhọhm kwẹ, obiro ọnang nnyanyaang sẹ ọchattọhk. Mada okk'mando asa, bẹ agbobhi mmokpatzọkhi sabẹ, bẹ achi ọttọhk, abira agwo atzuk.

K'ogbe kwa bẹ awobh k'ottemdamiji nwa, abibyanọng bani p'odedenmon nwa akhọri ọhọhm akhe k'ottem. Bẹ adani ọmma, am-akpẹbh ọtzaminọng kw'ọkhaam ọhọhm, aben bi, “Tzima ajinọng mba p'ahak m'ọhọhm kwọ kwu, ifha moyima bẹ abẹ.”
Mando kw'ọkhaam-ọhọhm oyini k'iyaan, oben ajinọng mba bi, “Mma e, ab'ayi, bọng obibyadik-dema nwa kasi e. Mada ojinọng nwa ode okhekhennọng kwaam, bọng ogbarsa-dik-dema nwa, kàsi.

Bọng kkeri, ominanwa kwaam ọmaana ọkkọra-kwanọng kw'ojinọng nwuma awobh ma e. Ńdima bẹ otzima nyin ka, ifha bọng ọtzọkha bẹ asi mach'achibhi pabọng ade. On-ode ojinọng nwa, bọng ogbarsa-dik-dema nwa kàsi.”

Kaambi mẹ wọ, ajinọng mba itzọhng kayong anang ọtzaminọng nwa. Mẹ wọ ofon, ofona-jinọng nwa kwa Lẹvi, ọtzọkha ọkkọra-kwanọng kwẹ ọnang ajinọng mba k'iyaan. Bẹ abọkh-ẹ k'ẹfa ayima abẹ m'erungiwu nduma biphyir. Mada ewu ehobh, bẹ atte kwanọng ọbọhk ofona.
M'owuhobha, kwanọng ọkpa nnam ochina k'ọhọhm kw'itta kwẹ om-owobha, otto owobha m'ibhokhi, oyima mẹ maa, ewu akyera ẹttaani.
K'ogbe kw'itta kwa kwanọng nwa ọn-ọphyọbh k'ekpebha, okwunga ọmma bi ochina ororo k'orenga kwẹ, on-ore ọkkọra-kwanọng kwẹ kw'ọkk'ọtta m'ọmma kw'ọhọhm, ọtzọkha mbọhk ọbọkha m'ọmma.
Itta kwẹ oben-ẹ bi, “Bina, mofona.” Yina, ẹmọng kosi. Mando kw'ojinọng nwa otzin-ẹ ọnana k'ẹnyanyaang otzim-ẹ ọbhana.
Mada bẹ apyiri k'ọhọhm, ọtzọkha okkoro ọkpọhk kwanọng ka ngọma-ka ngọma k'obe jobh obhiri afa, ọtzọkha ọtzọhm ka ngọma jobh obhiri mfa s'Israẹl.

Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ore kwẹ ọn-ọbhakhi oben oyok bi, “Bẹ odik-dema nwa atzim am-asa, anọng odik-dema nwa atzim am-ara, ttẹwọr k'ewu ch'iwa anọng p'Israẹl abin k'Ijip. Bọng chibhi odik nwa, mọkhaambi more odik okhuri kwẹ e!”
